package catalog

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/shopspring/decimal"

	"example.com/shop/internal/platform/security"
)

// ProductPolicy, as TestAPIListsWhatThePolicyNarrows writes it: no one
// signed in lists only the active products, and reads neither the inactive
// nor, past what Narrow says, the dear ones.
type ProductPolicy struct {
	productRules
}

func (ProductPolicy) Narrow(ctx context.Context, q *ProductQuery) {
	if !security.Allows(ctx, "user") {
		q.Filter.Status = []Status{StatusActive}
	}
}

func (p ProductPolicy) Read(ctx context.Context, x Product) bool {
	if security.Allows(ctx, "user") {
		return p.productRules.Read(ctx, x)
	}
	return p.productRules.Read(ctx, x) && x.Status == StatusActive && x.Price.LessThan(decimal.NewFromInt(1000))
}
